summary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The 0444 subject reproduces at the expected digest b080698512e632d285b25add1e196a49b84587d3e4ef986595d2d0045f4c4a2d at review start and end. All 7 cited path/digest pairs reproduce byte-exactly, and both Stage A occupancy verdicts are 0444 and independently ACCEPT at 0 blockers / 0 SHOULD-FIX with neither reviewer having read the other. Live remeasurement confirms every asserted value: HEAD a58ec0ae26de78cd9d04cac99d27500d3e46eed5, last live COORD heading D-211 with no D-212 present, required-now 28, condition 4 MET at 28 of 28 and 32 of 32, condition 2 unchanged at 4 of 32, condition 5 last, last gate row DR-G32, and DR-G10's status column reading exactly 'HARD-BLOCKED pending selector refresh'. v2's top-level head, recordedInputs.HEAD, file08Pin and requiredNowUnchanged all equal live values, and v2 stands CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED binding NOTHING. The frozen-v1 characterisation is not invented: v1's own bytes carry head 5d5d778, file 08 pin 3a9442d1, required-now 26, and a leftoverNameNote stating no leftover-join existed. D-187 is confirmed the current G10 leftover-join with no later G10 leftover recording, and the draft's remaining pair OBL-G10-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH matches both D-187 and v2. The D-167-through-D-211 non-unwrite span enumerates all 45 entries with D-168 present, no duplicates, in order. The gate-row sentence is the verbatim adopted house form and does not claim D-056 gates 2 and 3 fail. Thirty attacks were run; all thirty were refuted.
